body.purpose: Document prose; full editor width, 10 px paragraph rhythm.

headline.purpose: Document H1 only; first block, no top margin.

meta.purpose: Status bar, zoom readout, version chip; tabular numerals.

shadows.name: toolbar-lift
shadows.purpose: The one chrome shadow: separates the app toolbar from the document.

motion.name: thumb-ease
motion.purpose: Zoom slider thumb feedback only; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Flat Toolbar Button
components.description: Default toolbar control: quiet until hovered, pill shape, primary ink.
components.css: .ds-btn-flat { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 28px; padding: 0 12px; border: none; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: var(--g-color-text-primary); font: 500 13px/1.2 var(--g-font-family-sans, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.12s ease; } .ds-btn-flat:hover { background: var(--g-color-base-generic-hover); } .ds-btn-flat:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--g-color-text-primary); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The single brand-filled action of a dialog (Update, Insert at cursor).
components.css: .ds-btn-action { height: 28px; padding: 0 16px; border: none; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--g-color-base-brand, #ffdb4d); color: var(--g-color-text-primary, #1a1a1a); font: 500 13px/1.2 var(--g-font-family-sans, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.12s ease; } .ds-btn-action:hover { background: var(--g-color-base-brand-hover, #f0c400); } .ds-btn-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--g-color-text-primary); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Danger Outlined Action
components.description: Destructive confirmation (Replace document): outlined, never a filled red button.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { height: 28px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--g-color-line-generic, #d0c8a8); color: var(--g-color-text-danger-heavy, #b82820); font: 500 13px/1.2 var(--g-font-family-sans, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: var(--g-color-base-danger-light, #fbe4e0); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--g-color-text-primary); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Status Bar
components.description: 28 px identity strip: file name and path, save state with dot, word count and mode.
components.html: Q3 Release Notes.md~/NotesAll changes saved412 words · WYSIWYG
components.css: .ds-status { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; height: 28px; padding: 0 12px; border-top: 1px solid var(--g-color-line-generic, #d0c8a8); background: var(--g-color-base-generic, #eee8d5); color: var(--g-color-text-complementary, #586e75); font: 400 12px/1 var(--g-font-family-sans, sans-serif); } .ds-status-file { display: flex; gap: 8px; min-width: 0; max-width: 46%; } .ds-status-file b { color: var(--g-color-text-primary, #073642); font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-status-path { white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-status-state { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--g-color-base-positive-heavy, #859900); } .ds-status-meta { margin-left: auto; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Confirm Dialog
components.description: Gravity UI dialog on the float surface: caption names the state, consequence names real files, footer orders actions by risk.
components.html:
Replace document?

Opening “notes.md” replaces the current document. Unsaved changes in “Untitled” will be lost.
components.css: .ds-dialog { width: 340px; padding: 20px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--g-color-base-float, #fdf6e3); color: var(--g-color-text-primary, #073642); font: 400 15px/1.4 var(--g-font-family-sans, sans-serif); } .ds-dialog-caption { margin: 0 0 12px; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-dialog-body { margin: 0 0 16px; color: var(--g-color-text-primary, #073642); } .ds-dialog-footer { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; }

narrative.overview: GravityMD is a writing instrument, not a document portal: the page is the work, the chrome is the instrument's body. Everything above and below the prose is deliberately quiet — one hairline-bordered toolbar, one 28 px identity strip — and the document column is the only place that carries weight. The system inherits its material from Gravity UI and its warmth from the Solarized paper.
keyCharacteristics: Paper-first composition: one centred prose column, chrome at the edges.
Gravity UI geometry: pill controls, quiet flat surfaces, a single soft toolbar lift.
Three live themes (Dark / Light / Solarized) driven by the same token names.
Compact chrome (12–13 px, 28 px bars) against a 15 px / 1.45 body.
Semantic color only: brand for action, danger-strong for destructive state, positive/warning dots for status.

rules.name: The Chrome Whisper Rule
rules.body: Chrome never uses the brand accent. Accent appears only on the single primary action of the current dialog and on the caret; a toolbar with two yellow buttons has failed.

rules.name: The No Pure Black Rule
rules.body: Document text is --g-color-text-primary, never #000; the Solarized theme remaps it to ink on paper without touching component code.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: No second typeface is introduced for chrome or headings; when the hierarchy needs more contrast, use weight and space, not a new font.

rules.name: The Tabular Instrument Rule
rules.body: Every changing number (word count, zoom %, version) uses tabular-nums so counters do not jitter.

rules.name: The Single Lift Rule
rules.body: Only the app toolbar casts a shadow. Inner toolbars separate with a hairline, not with depth.

dos: Do keep the document the only high-contrast surface: chrome stays on base-generic, prose on base-background.
Do express state with a dot plus text ("Unsaved changes"), never colour alone.
Do let the document use the full editor width.
Do use tabular numerals for any counter that changes.
Do keep destructive actions outlined and last-to-Cancel in the footer order.
donts: Don't put the brand accent on chrome controls.
Don't add a second shadow or a card around the editing column.
Don't introduce a second typeface for headings or labels.
Don't show internal error codes (FS_*) as toast copy.
Don't hide essential toolbar actions below 860 px — collapse labels to icons.
